تحتشوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَشُوا (taḥtašū) /taħ.ta.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# تُحْتَشَوْا (tuḥtašaw) /tuħ.ta.ʃaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
